title: mouse without borders not work
author: Septemberlemon
summary: After applying the Settings workaround discussed in issue #50335, Mouse Without Borders cannot create a new security key and shows no paired devices.

judgment.rationale: The report identifies the affected module and two visible symptoms, but does not contain the pairing topology or a usable diagnostic archive needed to distinguish failed key generation from discovery, service, or configuration state. The live Needs-Author-Feedback label and existing upstream triage request already ask for those decision-changing details.
evidence: The issue specifies PowerToysUserSetup-0.101.2432.0-x64 from GitHub and is labeled Product-Mouse Without Borders.
The reporter says clicking New Key does nothing and no devices appear in the list after the Settings workaround from issue #50335.
The attached PowerToys report archive was rejected because it contains an oversized entry.
The only live comment requests concrete reproduction steps and a newly generated diagnostic ZIP; no author reply, assignee, linked fix, or duplicate resolution has appeared.
Issue #48196 is an open, unassigned Mouse Without Borders report with a broader connection-but-not-working symptom, not evidence that this key-generation failure is a duplicate.
judgment.recommended_action: Preserve the existing request for pairing-specific reproduction details and a usable fresh diagnostic archive; do not propose a code fix until the failing pairing stage is identified.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys fix may ultimately apply, but the current report does not identify a failing component or operation boundary. A proposed implementation would be speculative until the requested pairing evidence and usable diagnostics are supplied.
